name: 模版包管理 - 使用状态筛选与空结果边界
description: 验证使用状态筛选的两种状态值（使用中/未使用）的过滤正确性，以及筛选无结果时的空态展示

steps.expression: (() => { const labels = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-label, label'); for (const l of labels) { if (l.textContent.includes('使用状态')) { const sel = l.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-select'); if (sel) { sel.setAttribute('data-test-target', 'usage-status'); return true; } } } return false; })()

(() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); const texts = [...cards].map(c => c.textContent); const allActive = texts.every(t => !t.includes('未使用')); return { cardCount: cards.length, allShowActive: allActive }; })()
steps.description: 验证筛选后全部为使用中

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); const texts = [...cards].map(c => c.textContent); const allInactive = texts.every(t => !t.includes('使用中') || t.includes('未使用')); return { cardCount: cards.length, allShowInactive: allInactive }; })()
steps.description: 验证筛选后全部为未使用

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); const emptyText = document.body.innerText; return { cardCount: cards.length, hasEmptyState: emptyText.includes('暂无') || emptyText.includes('No data') || emptyText.includes('空') || cards.length === 0 }; })()
steps.description: 验证空结果时展示空态

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 使用状态为AntD Select（options: 全部/使用中/未使用）；空结果时可能显示AntD Empty组件或自定义空态。
